name: autosomal dominant slowed nerve conduction velocity
description: Autosomal dominant slowed nerve conduction velocity is a hereditary demyelinating motor and sensory neuropathy characterized by slowed nerve conduction velocities, in the absence of clinically apparent neurological deficits, gait abnormalities or muscular atrophy, associated with a germline mutation in the ARGHEF10 gene.
